name: Read Blueprint
description: Read the full construction blueprint, including block count, bounds, active levels, and main materials.

name: Split Blueprint
description: Divide the full blueprint into five logical Foreman regions for the demo.

name: Dispatch Regions
description: Send each Foreman its assigned region, worker pool, and construction constraints.

name: Collect Reports
description: Collect Foreman progress, blocker reports, repair notes, and reusable lessons.

name: Publish Skill
description: Turn repeated successful patterns into shared Skill Library entries for all Foremen and Workers.

name: Split Region
description: Split a Foreman's assigned region into smaller worker-sized subtasks.

name: Assign Subtasks
description: Assign generated subtasks to the Foreman's 20-worker logical pool.

name: Check Subtasks
description: Review which subtasks are open, claimed, complete, failed, or stalled.

name: Reassign Subtask
description: Reassign a failed or stalled subtask to another worker for repair.

name: Report Progress
description: Report region progress, blockers, and skill opportunities back to the PM.

name: Broadcast Skill
description: Share a learned skill or workaround with the Foreman's worker pool.

name: Read Subtask
description: Read the assigned subtask region and required materials before building.

name: Generate Script
description: Generate a bounded construction script for the assigned subtask.

name: Run Script
description: Execute the generated Minecraft construction script.

name: Verify Region
description: Verify that the built region matches the blueprint after execution.

name: Patch Region
description: Repair missing blocks, wrong blocks, or incomplete region work, then verify again.

name: Submit Result
description: Submit the subtask result to the Foreman after verification.

name: Scaffold
description: Place temporary support blocks inside the assigned region and mark them for cleanup.
sharedTo: PM, Foreman-A, Foreman-B, Foreman-C, Foreman-D, Foreman-E, Workers

name: Build Region
description: Place all required blocks for a subtask region using a generated script, then verify against the blueprint.
sharedTo: PM, Foreman-A, Foreman-B, Foreman-C, Foreman-D, Foreman-E, Workers

name: Replace Region
description: Find wrong blocks in a region, replace them with the blueprint material, and verify the correction.
sharedTo: PM, Foreman-A, Foreman-B, Foreman-C, Foreman-D, Foreman-E, Workers

name: Clean Region
description: Remove scaffold, leftovers, or incorrect blocks inside a bounded region without touching valid blueprint blocks.
sharedTo: PM, Foreman-A, Foreman-B, Foreman-C, Foreman-D, Foreman-E, Workers
